item.mood_swings.lockdown.tooltip.primar: Lock all doors in the selected area for 30 seconds.
item.mood_swings.lockdown.tooltip.crowba: This will ignore all doors forced open by a crowbar.
screen.mood_swings.lockdown.title: Area Lockdown
screen.mood_swings.lockdown.subtitle: Choose an area to secure.
screen.mood_swings.lockdown.empty: No Lockdown Areas are available in this dimension.
config.mood_swings.title: Mood Swings
config.mood_swings.no_server_data: No server data is available yet. Join a world, then reopen this screen.
config.mood_swings.read_only: You can view these save settings, but operator permission is required to edit them.
config.mood_swings.task.native_note: Native Wathe task. Mood Swings can enable or disable it, but its built-in logic is not JSON-configurable.
config.mood_swings.task.blocks_passive_i: Pauses Wathe passive income until this task is completed or cleared.
config.mood_swings.task.reset: Reset this task to datapack defaults
config.mood_swings.task.unknown_conditio: This task uses an unknown condition type. Edit its JSON file directly.
config.mood_swings.areas.help: Create areas with /moodswings area pos1, /moodswings area pos2 and /moodswings area save <name>. Existing areas can be renamed, deleted and outlined here.
config.mood_swings.areas.empty: No named areas exist in this save.
config.mood_swings.lockdown.description: Lockdown is a killer shop ability that closes and temporarily jams every Wathe door inside a selected Lockdown Area.
config.mood_swings.lockdown.enabled.tool: When disabled, Lockdown is removed from Wathe's killer shop for this save.
config.mood_swings.lockdown.status.enabl: Lockdown is enabled in this save.
config.mood_swings.lockdown.status.disab: Lockdown is disabled in this save.
config.mood_swings.lockdown.requirement: Lockdown uses its own regions and never reads Mood task areas or OST Areas. Every Wathe door variant inside the selected Lockdown Area is affected unless it has already been forced open by a crowbar.
text.autoconfig.mood_swings.title: Mood Swings
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.mood_swin: Data-driven Wathe mood tasks, dedicated Lockdown Areas, environmental kill credit, configurable Lockdown gameplay and synchronized atmospheric OST regions.
config.mood_swings.ost_areas.description: OST Areas control synchronized, looping ambience streams. They are stored separately and never count as task areas.
config.mood_swings.ost_areas.help: Create regions with /moodswings ostarea pos1, /moodswings ostarea pos2 and /moodswings ostarea save <name> <sound_id>.
config.mood_swings.ost_areas.enabled: Enable OST Areas in this save
config.mood_swings.ost_areas.enabled.too: When disabled, all active OST ambience fades out and no OST region is evaluated.
config.mood_swings.ost_areas.status.enab: OST Areas are enabled in this save.
config.mood_swings.ost_areas.status.disa: OST Areas are disabled in this save.
config.mood_swings.ost_areas.empty: No OST Areas exist in this save.
config.mood_swings.ost_areas.sound.toolt: Example: mood_swings:museum_gallery. The sound event must exist in a client resource pack or installed mod.
config.mood_swings.ost_areas.priority.to: Higher values override lower values when regions overlap. Smaller regions win equal-priority ties.
config.mood_swings.ost_areas.fade.toolti: Used for both fade-in and fade-out. Allowed range: 0 to 30 seconds.
config.mood_swings.ost_areas.summary: Sound: %s | Volume: %s | Priority: %s | Fade: %ss | Wind: %s | Darkness: %s
config.mood_swings.ost_areas.shake.toolt: 0 disables camera motion. Higher values create a smooth wind-like push rather than rapid combat shake; the area fade controls how it enters and leaves.
screen.mood_swings.lockdown.empty_hint: Create them with /moodswings lockdown area pos1, pos2 and save.
screen.mood_swings.lockdown.hover_action: Click to lock every Wathe door for %s seconds
config.mood_swings.lockdown.areas.help: Create dedicated regions with /moodswings lockdown area pos1, /moodswings lockdown area pos2 and /moodswings lockdown area save <name>.
config.mood_swings.lockdown.areas.empty: No Lockdown Areas exist in this save.
config.mood_swings.ost_areas.darkness.to: 0 disables darkening. 1 applies the strongest black world overlay. The HUD, chat, inventories and other GUI screens render above it and remain undarkened.
